ip.description: Voter IP; `null` once the vote outlived the retention period of personal data

ref.description: Opaque `ref` from the vote link, returned as is

serverSlug.description: Slug of the game server the voter picked, if any

data.description: The vote, in the same shape as the vote feed; `ip` is always set

refs.description: Refs to look up: 1..500, each non-blank, at most 128 characters, without control characters

platformApiKey.description: API key of the tenant, sent as `Authorization: Bearer nx_api_...`. The key determines the tenant; the scopes granted to it determine which operations it may call.

info.description:
Votes cast on l2nx.top for your tenant (your project on the L2NX platform), for granting in-game rewards: a vote feed by cursor, a lookup by the `ref` you put into the vote link, and the `vote.created` webhook.

Authenticate with an API key of the tenant sent as `Authorization: Bearer nx_api_...`; the key needs the scope `top.votes:read`. The key determines the tenant: no request parameter selects it, and every response holds only that tenant's votes. How to get a key, and the error codes: [Authentication](https://l2nx.dev/api/authentication/).
info.title: nx-top — Integration API

get.description:
**🔑 Integration — API key**

Votes in id order after the `after` cursor, from the oldest without it. An empty `votes` array is the end of the feed; poll again later with the id of the last vote seen. Votes of the last 10 seconds are held back so that no vote is ever skipped behind the cursor.

**Filters:**
- `after` — Id of the last vote already seen

parameters.description: Id of the last vote already seen
parameters.name: after

401.description: No `Authorization: Bearer` header, a malformed key or an unknown key

403.description: The key is not allowed here; `code` is `API_KEY_REVOKED`, `API_KEY_EXPIRED`, `TENANT_SUSPENDED`, `TENANT_CLOSED` (on a shared host; on a tenant host a suspended or closed tenant gets `404 TENANT_NOT_FOUND`), `API_KEY_TENANT_MISMATCH` (a key of another tenant than the host) or `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE`

429.description: Too many requests with this key to this operation (`RATE_LIMITED`); limits: https://l2nx.dev/api/overview/#rate-limits

post.description:
**🔑 Integration — API key**

Every vote carrying one of the `refs`; a ref with no vote is simply absent.

400.description: `VALIDATION_FAILED`: 1..500 refs, each non-blank, at most 128 characters, without control characters

401.description: No `Authorization: Bearer` header, a malformed key or an unknown key

403.description: The key is not allowed here; `code` is `API_KEY_REVOKED`, `API_KEY_EXPIRED`, `TENANT_SUSPENDED`, `TENANT_CLOSED` (on a shared host; on a tenant host a suspended or closed tenant gets `404 TENANT_NOT_FOUND`), `API_KEY_TENANT_MISMATCH` (a key of another tenant than the host) or `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE`

429.description: Too many requests with this key to this operation (`RATE_LIMITED`); limits: https://l2nx.dev/api/overview/#rate-limits

tags.description: Votes of the API key's tenant, for reward reconciliation
tags.name: Integration: votes

post.description: Sent to the tenant's webhook URL once per vote, shortly after the vote is recorded. Verify `webhook-signature` before trusting the body and deduplicate by `webhook-id`: delivery is at-least-once. Any non-2xx response, a redirect or no response within 10 seconds is retried with growing delays for about a day, then the delivery is abandoned; the vote feed remains the source for reconciliation.

parameters.description: Event id (UUIDv7), the same on every retry; not `data.id`
parameters.name: webhook-id

parameters.description: Send time of this attempt, epoch seconds; signed, so a stale value exposes a replay
parameters.name: webhook-timestamp

parameters.description: `v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256>` of `{webhook-id}.{webhook-timestamp}.{body}` keyed with the tenant's webhook secret
parameters.name: webhook-signature
